blocks.content:
Legislative Assembly:
• Speaker
• Deputy Speaker

Legislative Council:
• Chairman
• Deputy Chairman

items: Ensure you do not confuse the Speaker (Assembly) with the Chairman (Council) in match-the-following questions.
Remember that Legislative Assembly has a Deputy Speaker, whereas Legislative Council has a Deputy Chairman.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Legislative Assembly is presided over by the Speaker and the Deputy Speaker.
The Legislative Council is presided over by the Chairman and the Deputy Chairman.
Presiding officers differ depending on whether the house is the Legislative Assembly or Legislative Council.
